tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List the wine regions WildAlmonds covers (slugs for other tools).

tools.name: get_this_weekend
tools.description: This weekend's wine guide for a region: the published guide plus its verified event listings (what's on, where, when, wines being poured where confirmed).

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming winery events in a region, optionally filtered by date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: get_winery
tools.description: Details for one winery by name: website, address, phone, events page, and its wine catalog. Reports whether the winery is closed.

tools.name: submit_event_info
tools.description: Get the link wineries use to submit their own events for the weekly guide.
